photos.c: BEATEN BY INCHES! Bravo, Brickwood ! And bravo, Allum ! Brickwood, going strongly, reaches the tape to win the London-Brighton relay race for Mitcham A.C. Hard on his heels is Allum, last man for Belgrave Harriers. Belgrave had won the past three races, but, despite a gallant effort, they could not quite succeed this year. The winning club's time was 3 h. 52 m. 5 s. for the course of nearly forty-six miles.
